decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (Application Form, Design and Access Statement, Site Plan, Bedford Park Balustrade Profiles and Fixing Drawing, Drawing Numbers 854/05, 06 received 09/09/11.) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.
Condition : 4 - External brickwork and face bond shall conform to the advice in Technical Note 1 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook.
Condition : 5 - External joinery details shall conform to the advice in Technical Note 3 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook.
description: Listed building consent for the erection of a timber balustrade on the first floor rear roof terrace, the removal of the render on the first floor rear addition wall and minor alterations to provide a utility room off the kitchen.
